title: Toast: Sticky SaaS - [Business Breakdowns, EP.247]

reader_summary.headline: Toast built a resilient, profitable restaurant operating system that keeps customers loyal.
reader_summary.overview: Toast serves as a full operating system for restaurants, offering software, hardware, and payments. The company uses AI to update features instantly and collects data to build new products. Its durable hardware and strong culture make it hard for competitors to copy.

key_points.text: Toast acts like a full operating system for restaurants, similar to how Shopify works for retail stores.
key_points.evidence_quote: Toast is really the full operating system for their businesses. Think of it like Shopify for restaurants.

key_points.text: The company uses AI to quickly update its software for all customers at once.
key_points.evidence_quote: Because it's a modern multi-tenant SaaS solution, they can code once and then deploy all the updates with new AI models and with new technologies rapidly to the whole customer base.

key_points.text: Toast builds its own durable hardware because standard tablets break easily in the messy restaurant environment.
key_points.evidence_quote: Turns out iPads don't work very well in restaurants. They break all the time. They don't do well with water and liquid and heat.

key_points.text: Toast IQ lets owners change menus and prices instantly by talking to the system instead of working all weekend.
key_points.evidence_quote: You can talk to your toast IQ. You can ask it questions. You can make menu changes across the board.

key_points.text: Toast keeps low customer loss rates because its software makes restaurant businesses more profitable and resilient.
key_points.evidence_quote: their businesses are so much more profitable using toast than they were otherwise, that they just become healthier businesses that survive more.
